title: Denoising Diffusion Implicit Models
summary: Introduces a non-Markovian deterministic sampling path that enables much faster generation than ancestral DDPM sampling.

title: DPM-Solver: A Fast ODE Solver for Diffusion Probabilistic Model Sampling in Around 10 Steps
summary: Treats diffusion sampling as a dedicated ODE integration problem and develops high-order low-NFE solvers.

title: Progressive Distillation for Fast Sampling of Diffusion Models
summary: Repeatedly distills two denoising steps into one, forming the canonical progressive step-halving strategy.

title: Consistency Models
summary: Introduces a consistency mapping that supports one-step or few-step generation.

title: Latent Consistency Models: Synthesizing High-Resolution Images with Few-Step Inference
summary: Transfers consistency distillation into latent text-to-image models for practical few-step generation.

title: One-step Diffusion with Distribution Matching Distillation
summary: Matches the student output distribution to the diffusion teacher to enable one-step generation.

title: Improved Distribution Matching Distillation for Fast Image Synthesis
summary: Improves distribution matching distillation and becomes an important base for later few-step image/video systems.

title: DeepCache: Accelerating Diffusion Models for Free
summary: Reuses high-level U-Net features across adjacent denoising steps to reduce repeated computation.

title: Learning-to-Cache: Accelerating Diffusion Transformer via Layer Caching
summary: Learns layer-wise caching behavior for diffusion transformers rather than using a fixed handcrafted schedule.

title: FORA: Fast-Forward Caching in Diffusion Transformer Acceleration
summary: Reuses transformer attention/MLP computations across denoising steps.

title: TeaCache: Timestep Embedding Tells Cache for Efficient Diffusion Transformer
summary: Uses timestep-embedding-derived signals to estimate feature change and adapt cache decisions.

title: TaylorSeer: From Reusing to Forecasting in Efficient Diffusion
summary: Moves diffusion cache from direct reuse toward Taylor-style feature forecasting.

title: Forecast the Principal, Stabilize the Residual: Subspace-Aware Feature Caching for Diffusion Models
summary: Decomposes features into subspaces, forecasting the dynamic principal component while reusing stable residual structure.

title: Denoising as Path Planning: Training-Free Acceleration of Diffusion Models with DPCache
summary: Recasts cache schedule selection as a global path-planning problem instead of making isolated local decisions.

title: D2Cache: Second-Order Delta Caching for Higher Video Diffusion Acceleration
summary: Uses second-order delta information to improve predictive caching under aggressive video acceleration.

title: Accelerating Autoregressive Video Diffusion via History-Guided Cache and Residual Correction
summary: Adapts caching to autoregressive video diffusion by using rollout history and residual correction.

title: WorldCache: Heterogeneous Token Caching for Accelerating Video World Models
summary: Introduces token-heterogeneous cache decisions for long-horizon video world-model generation.

title: Token Merging for Fast Stable Diffusion
summary: Reduces redundant spatial tokens through training-free token merging during diffusion inference.

title: DiTFastAttn: Attention Compression for Diffusion Transformer Models
summary: Exploits spatial, temporal and classifier-free-guidance redundancy to compress attention computation in DiTs.

title: Q-Diffusion: Quantizing Diffusion Models
summary: A foundational post-training quantization framework that accounts for diffusion timestep characteristics.

title: Structural Pruning for Diffusion Models
summary: Prunes diffusion network structure to obtain a smaller inference model.

title: CacheQuant: Comprehensively Accelerated Diffusion Models
summary: Co-designs feature caching and quantization rather than treating them as independent approximations.

title: DistriFusion: Distributed Parallel Inference for High-Resolution Diffusion Models
summary: Uses patch parallelism and cross-step feature similarity to reduce communication overhead in distributed inference.

title: xDiT: an Inference Engine for Diffusion Transformers
summary: Combines sequence parallelism, PipeFusion and CFG parallelism for scalable diffusion-transformer inference.

title: FastVideo
summary: A compound video-generation framework integrating few-step distillation, sparse attention and optimized inference.

title: LightX2V
summary: A deployment-oriented compound acceleration framework combining distillation, quantization, sparse attention, caching and offload.
